# Daily Briefing – Friday 20 November

Yesterday was a quieter day overall — no training session logged and 6,383 steps, though your body still burned 2,394 kcal, so your metabolism is working well. The main flag is sleep: 5.7 hours isn't enough to support your goals, and it's showing in your HRV sitting at 71ms against your 90-119ms baseline — that's a meaningful dip worth taking seriously.

With HRV this suppressed, today isn't the day to push hard. If you have a session planned, dial intensity back — think easy aerobic or mobility work. Your resting HR of 55 bpm and stress score of 41 aren't alarming, but combined with poor sleep, your body is signalling it needs support, not stress.

Prioritise sleep tonight above everything — aim for 8 hours minimum. It'll do more for your Chester prep right now than any extra training session will.
